rubric_items.reason: All known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-4) and the assumed REQ-5 are traced: S-1 covers REQ-1, REQ-2 and REQ-5, and S-2 covers REQ-3 and REQ-4.
S-2 has one outcome. S-1 combines showing the count, updating it, and the paging scope under one outcome. That is acceptable but slightly broad.
Every criterion uses Given/When/Then. S-1 AC3 can only be checked if the list is paged, which is still unknown (U-1).
The values '12 patients' and '0 patients' come straight from the intent's REQ-1 and REQ-3. No invented limits.
Readable and consistent. The body's acceptance criteria are shortened versions of the front-matter text, and the front-matter U-1 has no text.

findings.text: Claim C1 says Front-desk staff are the users of the patient list. The cited glossary entry only says they register patients and book appointments. It never mentions the patient list.

cites.quote: The hospital staff who register patients and book, move and close appointments
The users of the patient list are `Front-desk staff`.

findings.suggested_fix: Reword C1 so it matches what the glossary says, or cite the ticket or intent line that names the users of the patient list.

findings.text: The intent's U-2/Q-02 (wording for exactly one match, default '1 patient') is not carried into the split. No story or criterion covers the one-match case, and it is not listed as unknown.

cites.quote: The ticket gives the plural form only; the wording for exactly one match is not stated.
U-1 (non-blocking): whether the count is of every match or of one page if the list is paged (Q-01).

findings.suggested_fix: Carry U-2/Q-02 forward as a non-blocking unknown and question, or add an assumed criterion for one match that is marked as relying on Q-02's default.

findings.text: In the front matter, unknown U-1 has only an id and a blocking flag, with no text. The body's acceptance criteria are also looser rewordings of the front-matter ones, e.g. S-1 AC2 'the count follows the new search'.

cites.quote: then the count follows the new search.

findings.suggested_fix: Add text (and question: Q-01) to the front-matter U-1, and make the body's acceptance criteria match the front-matter wording.
